grooveHunter01.name: Against the Odds
grooveHunter01.description: With disadvantage, a matching pair other than two 6s grants one hit at most.

grooveHunter02.name: Utter Determination
grooveHunter02.description: With disadvantage, wounded traits from the chosen approach may still add their dice to the pool.

grooveHunter03.name: Virtue of Necessity
grooveHunter03.description: A trait adjacent to a wounded trait in the approach may replace it, even when it belongs to another approach.

grooveHunter04.name: Out of the Box
grooveHunter04.description: After rolling, trigger one shock to turn a result from 2 to 5 into a 6.

grooveHunter05.name: Lone Wolf
grooveHunter05.description: Rock traits are available for Blues and Jazz Tests.

grooveHunter06.name: Scrap Master
grooveHunter06.description: With disadvantage, reroll the removed die, then choose whether to keep its new result.

grooveHunter07.name: Loose Handcuffs
grooveHunter07.description: Tango traits are available for Dance and Jazz Tests.

grooveHunter08.name: Mirror of the Soul
grooveHunter08.description: Dance traits are available for Tango and Blues Tests.

grooveHunter09.name: Long Term Plan
grooveHunter09.description: After a roll, save one die result, then voluntarily add it to a later Test in the same Session. Only one result remains saved.

grooveHunter10.name: Faster than the Eye
grooveHunter10.description: Jazz traits are available for Dance and Rock Tests.

grooveHunter11.name: Memento of War
grooveHunter11.description: Blues traits are available for Tango and Rock Tests.

groovePrime001.name: Planetary Threat
groovePrime001.description: After every two Bounty Hunter Tests, increase the Tab difficulty by 1.

groovePrime002.name: Master Bomber
groovePrime002.description: For one Risk and this Tab, Tests using the Session Genre roll one fewer die and all other approaches produce at least two shocks.

groovePrime003.name: Orbital Kidnapping
groovePrime003.description: Big Shot manages the 4-clock ‘The Hostages Are Safe’, then marks it closed; 1s on Tests using the Session Genre no longer cause shocks.
reminders: Open the 4-clock ‘The Hostages Are Safe’; the first hit from every Session Genre Test advances it. Then activate the state on the Bounty.

groovePrime004.name: Tools of the Trade
groovePrime004.description: Outside a Test, spend one Risk to swap the objectives of two open clocks; this cannot be used after the Secret is revealed.

groovePrime005.name: Master Key
groovePrime005.description: Before a Test, a Bounty Hunter may add 3 to the Tab's difficulty for the whole Session and 1d6 to their pool. Two hits from the Test cancel the accumulated shift.

groovePrime006.name: Digitalized Mind
groovePrime006.description: For one Risk, non-improvised actions have disadvantage while improvised actions have advantage.

groovePrime007.name: Remote Control
groovePrime007.description: For one Risk, Tests using the Session Genre have disadvantage until the end of the Tab.

groovePrime008.name: Dangerous Goods
groovePrime008.description: A MONO trait may absorb a third shock. Big Shot adjudicates a MONO's destruction and the Tab's failure.
reminders: If a MONO is destroyed, the Tab fails; Big Shot manages that destruction and its consequences.

groovePrime009.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
groovePrime009.description: For one Risk, the Bounty Hunters must spend one hit at the end of each Test on a clock chosen by Big Shot.

groovePrime010.name: Until the End
groovePrime010.description: For one Risk and this Tab, a Test with no hits adds two shocks and a Test with one hit adds one shock.

groovePrime011.name: Escape Artist
groovePrime011.description: When a clock other than a 4-clock closes, spend one Risk to open a smaller special clock which must also be filled.

groovePrime012.name: Do or Die
groovePrime012.description: Require one hit from each Test to fill the protective 8-clock, then a 6-clock for one Risk, then a 4-clock for another Risk.

groovePrime013.name: Fictional Identity
groovePrime013.description: Nobody may assign disadvantage to Tests, and Assist or Jam! no longer removes wounds.

groovePrime014.name: Secret Mission
groovePrime014.description: Session Genre Tests have disadvantage until the Secret is revealed.
reminders: Only Tests of that Genre may close objective clocks.

groovePrime015.name: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Cold
groovePrime015.description: Big Shot selects the Bounty Hunter whose Memory is linked to the Bounty; they may spend Rhythm as Bullets or Bullets as Rhythm.

groovePrime016.name: Special Raid
groovePrime016.description: For one Risk, Tests outside the Session Genre have disadvantage until the end of the Tab.

groovePrime017.name: High View
groovePrime017.description: Bounty Hunters cannot spend hits to reduce the difficulty unless they play Solo!.

groovePrime018.name: A Smaller Fish Bites Harder
groovePrime018.description: Absorbing a shock with a trait requires wounding one additional trait; the Bullet cost remains unchanged.

groovePrime019.name: A Ruined Life
groovePrime019.description: Give clock events deliberately vague descriptions so their true objective and consequences remain uncertain.

groovePrime020.name: When You Look Into the Abyss…
groovePrime020.description: For one Risk, wounds cannot be removed before the end of the Tab or the revelation of the Secret.

groovePrime021.name: …The Abyss Looks Into You
groovePrime021.description: For one Risk, wounds cannot be removed before the end of the Tab or the revelation of the Secret.

groovePrime022.name: Shadows of the Past
groovePrime022.description: Big Shot selects two Bounty Hunters: every payment containing Rhythm also costs them two Bullets. After the Secret is manually accepted, Risk payments are doubled.
